input.summary: Ported reduction.cu + kernels.h to idiomatic SYCL 2020. The migrated sources are now migrated/kernels.h (a single templated functor atomic_reduction_kernel<V>, V = 1/2/4/8/16, using nd_item<1> grid-stride loops and sycl::atomic_ref fetch_add with device scope) and migrated/reduction.cpp (sycl::queue in-order, sycl::malloc_device/memcpy/memset, nd_range<1> launches via a lambda benchmark helper, same grid sizes min(ceil(n/bs), 2048) / V, same output file format). No dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros or <dpct/...> includes remain. reduction_input.hpp is unchanged. The sources compile with icpx -fsycl with zero diagnostics and without the dpct include path (add_dpct_include=false). I did not run the binary, so numerical equality with the CUDA reference is not yet verified by a run; the sums are integer sums of 0/1 values (max 16M, no overflow), so the result is order-independent and should match exactly.
